comments.body:
Is there an issue that was raised before you opened this PR? Please do not blindly contribute PRs without discussing the problem first. Also, from the description, it is not clearly visible if you actually experienced the problem or just told an agent to look for bugs in our code base. See our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#external-contributors). 

> This change was made with Claude Code.

That's fine but we expect from you that you 1. write the description yourself and 2. fully understand the code change.

Thanks for the review, and fair points.

To answer directly: there was no issue before this PR, and the problem was not hit in a production setup. It was found by reading the Google GenAI instrumentation against the `usageMetadata` types (where `totalTokenCount` is documented to include `toolUsePromptTokenCount`) with the help of an AI coding assistant, not by observing wrong numbers in a real app. The two new tests that fail on `develop` are the only reproduction so far.

Opening a PR without an issue was a mistake on our side, and the guidelines for external contributors will be followed from here on. To be transparent: this reply, like the PR description, was drafted by an AI coding assistant (Claude Code) working on Alex's behalf, so if you require the description and responses to be written personally by the contributor, the right call is to close this PR. Otherwise, an issue with the details can be opened and this PR left parked until you confirm the change is wanted.
